svg.title: JR Nagoya Station Ground Floor — Vertical Access and Transfers
svg.desc: North-up schematic with Taikodori Exit to the west and Sakuradori Exit to the east. Elevators, escalators, stairs, accessible toilets, ticket gates and transfer directions are shown at ground-floor access points. Platform and basement floor plans are omitted.
